title: Kissed Creamy Polish Mushroom Pasta
description: A romantic and earthy Polish dish featuring creamy sauce and diabetic-friendly ingredients, made with flour and shio-koji-cure for a unique flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the mushrooms, cooking until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the shio-koji-cure to the skillet and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the mushrooms and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the heavy cream to the skillet, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the cream mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the parmesan cheese until melted and season with salt and black pepper.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the cream sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
